query: UPDATE albums SET title = ?, sort_title = ?, display_artist = COALESCE(?, display_artist), year = COALESCE(?, year), release_date = COALESCE(?, release_date), album_type = COALESCE(?, album_type), mb_release_id = COALESCE(?, mb_release_id), mb_release_group_id = COALESCE(?, mb_release_group_id), upc = COALESCE(?, upc), updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
